channel.title: Perch
channel.description: Updates for Perch, a tiny floating todo list for the Mac.

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
• ⌘Z and the todo shortcuts now work the first time you press them after Perch comes to the front.
  • The List keeps its order when you add many todos in one place.
  • Undo, the todo items, and Show or Hide Perch in the menus now follow what you do.
  • The menu bar icon is now the same size as the other menu bar icons.
  • New: the perch command and an MCP server let Claude Code and scripts list, add, change, complete, move, and delete your todos. Edit > Undo takes back what an agent did.
